stock.description: Peiport Holdings Ltd. functions as an investment holding entity, specializing in offering an array of thermal imaging, self-stabilized imaging, and general aviation products and related services. Its operations span across both the People's Republic of China and global markets. The company's business is structured around three distinct divisions: Thermal Imaging Products and Services, Self-Stabilised Imaging Products and Services, and General Aviation Products and Services. Within its comprehensive thermal imaging portfolio, Peiport supplies gimbal systems, Rotax engines, and integrated thermal solutions like unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) thermographic inspection and infrared body temperature screening systems. It also provides advanced infrared and ultraviolet cameras, alongside various optoelectronic systems for diverse applications such as partial discharge monitoring, nano-positioning, electrical ultrasonic and X-ray inspection, fully automatic sports timing, industrial videoscopes and borespores, ground penetration radar, concrete imaging, motion analysis, high-speed imaging, ultra-portable explosives trace detection, and thermal imager testing. These thermal imaging products, sold under brands like PTi, primarily cater to consumer, commercial, and industrial sectors. The self-stabilized imaging division develops and provides solutions designed for aerial platforms such as aircraft and helicopters, as well as maritime applications on vessels and ships. These products are offered under brand names including SkyEye, SeaVision, and PGs. Additionally, the company offers rental services for aircraft-mounted stabilized imaging equipment. In the general aviation segment, Peiport Holdings Ltd. distributes engines and associated components for light and ultra-light aircraft. It further supports this sector by providing comprehensive maintenance training courses and ongoing maintenance and support services. Its diverse clientele for general aviation includes light and ultra-light aircraft manufacturers, flight schools, flying entertainment clubs, specialized light aircraft research institutions, and private aircraft owners. Established in 1998, Peiport Holdings Ltd. is headquartered in Tai Po, Hong Kong, and operates as a subsidiary of Peiport Alpha Ltd.
